summary: Walks the global doubly-linked list rooted at dword_8B8F14 (nodes linked through +0x12C prev / +0x130 next), removing and freeing every node whose flag byte at +0x114 has bit 3 (value 8) set. The loop iterates one node ahead of the node it inspects, so a look-ahead node's predecessor is tested; a trailing check processes the final node that the loop advances past. Each removal unlinks the node with null-checked reciprocal pointer patches, runs DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks and EmptyStub_7470 on it, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and decrements the global node count dword_8B6AC0. Returns 0.

local_names.v2: node inspected for removal (predecessor of iterate)

operations.description: Seed the traversal cursor v0 with the list head global dword_8B8F14; the head's +0x130 next link supplies the first loop iterate.
If the list head dword_8B8F14 is null, skip the whole traversal and fall through to the return.

Iterate the list starting from the head's +0x130 next link; each iteration re-cursors v0 to the current iterate and reads v2 = iterate's +0x12C prev link, then advances through the current node's +0x130 link.
Test the inspected node v2's flag byte at +0x114 for bit 3 (value 8); only matching nodes are unlinked, cleaned and freed.
Unlink: if the inspected node v2's +0x12C prev link is non-null, patch that prev node's +0x130 next link to skip over v2 (pointing at v2's own +0x130).
Unlink: if the inspected node v2's +0x130 next link is non-null, patch that next node's +0x12C prev link to skip back over v2 (pointing at v2's own +0x12C).
If the inspected node v2 has no +0x12C prev link (it was the list head), promote v2's +0x130 successor into the head global dword_8B8F14.
Run DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks on the removed node v2.
Invoke the empty stub EmptyStub_7470 on the removed node v2.
Release the removed node's heap block v2 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Decrement the global node count dword_8B6AC0 by one for each removal.

After the loop, re-test the last visited node v0 for the same bit-3 flag at +0x114 and apply the identical unlink/cleanup/free sequence, covering the tail node whose flag is never tested during the look-ahead iteration.
Return 0 unconditionally; the function reports no error or status value.
